sentences.en: This is 99% Invisible.
sentences.zh: 这里是99%隐形播客。

sentences.en: I'm Roman Mars.
sentences.zh: 我是罗曼·马尔斯。

sentences.en: Here's something you probably didn't know about Mumbai, India.
sentences.zh: 接下来要讲的是你可能不知道的关于印度孟买的一件事。

sentences.en: There are about 55 acres of dense, overgrown forest right downtown.
sentences.zh: 就在市中心，有一片大约55英亩茂密蔓生的森林。

sentences.en: In one of the most populous cities in the world, this is a place where peacocks roam freely.
sentences.zh: 在这座世界上人口最稠密的城市之一，这是一个孔雀自由漫步的地方。

sentences.en: A place that seems to peel back centuries.
sentences.zh: 一个仿佛能剥开数百年时光的地方。

sentences.en: This forest is protected by a religious community.
sentences.zh: 这片森林由一个宗教社群保护着。

sentences.en: It has survived undeveloped in the middle of this gargantuan city.
sentences.zh: 它在这座庞大城市的正中央未受开发地保存了下来。

sentences.en: Importantly, it's also home to an ancient tradition that's in crisis.
sentences.zh: 更重要的是，这里也是一个陷入危机中的古老传统的发源地。

sentences.en: One of our producers, Lasha Madan, traveled there in September.
sentences.zh: 我们的制作人之一拉莎·马丹在9月前往了那里。

sentences.en: I turned off a busy road to get here,
sentences.zh: 我从一条繁忙的路上拐弯来到这里，

sentences.en: step through a large iron archway and up a small hill.
sentences.zh: 穿过一个巨大的铁艺拱门，走上一个小山丘。

sentences.en: The monsoon's long gone, but the air still feels heavy with moisture.
sentences.zh: 季风早已过去，但空气中依然带着湿润的沉闷感。

sentences.en: Behind me, tall buildings shimmer in a haze of pollution.
sentences.zh: 在我身后，高楼大厦在污染的雾霾中闪烁。

sentences.en: And up ahead, I see a sprawling expanse of green.
sentences.zh: 而在前方，我看到了一片绵延的绿意。

sentences.en: This forest is called Dungravadi.
sentences.zh: 这片森林被称为邓格拉瓦迪。

sentences.en: As you step in from the harsh sunlight and road outside,
sentences.zh: 当你从外面刺眼的阳光和大路走进这里时，

sentences.en: you just step into an extremely quiet place.
sentences.zh: 你瞬间就步入了一个极其安静的地方。

sentences.en: This is Rashnit Pardiwala, someone who grew up in Mumbai and knows this place intimately.
sentences.zh: 这位是拉什尼·帕迪瓦拉，一个在孟买长大、对这里了如指掌的人。

sentences.en: You can hear the dry leaves rustling below your footsteps.
sentences.zh: 你能听到脚下干树叶的沙沙声。

sentences.en: The forest is dark and deep.
sentences.zh: 森林深邃而黑暗。

sentences.en: There are different trees in bloom.
sentences.zh: 各种树木正在盛开。

sentences.en: Wild banana, mango, jackfruit, tamarind.
sentences.zh: 野香蕉、芒果、菠萝蜜、罗望子。

sentences.en: I saw one whole tree just covered with fruit bats,
sentences.zh: 我看到整棵树上都挂满了果蝠，

sentences.en: chittering away.
sentences.zh: 唧唧喳喳叫个不停。

sentences.en: The vegetation here is dense.
sentences.zh: 这里的植被非常茂密。

sentences.en: It's so thick, you've got to bend,
sentences.zh: 茂密到你必须弯下腰，

sentences.en: you've got to see where you're stepping.
sentences.zh: 必须看清你踩的每一步。

sentences.en: But there's a certain point in this forest
sentences.zh: 但在森林里的某个特定点之后，

sentences.en: beyond which almost no one can step.
sentences.zh: 几乎没有人能够再往前走。

sentences.en: Not Rushne, and certainly not me.
sentences.zh: 拉什内不能，我当然更不能。

sentences.en: Only special caretakers of these grounds can go any further.
sentences.zh: 只有这些土地的专属看护人才能再往前走。

sentences.en: They go by many names.
sentences.zh: 他们有许多不同的称呼。

sentences.en: Kandia, Nusasalar, Paulbearer, Corpsebearer.
sentences.zh: 坎迪亚、努萨萨拉、抬棺人、尸体运送者。

sentences.en: Regardless of title, their work here is holy.
sentences.zh: 无论头衔如何，他们在这里的工作都是神圣的。

sentences.en: They carry dead bodies to their final resting place,
sentences.zh: 他们将尸体运送到最后的安息之地，

sentences.en: atop stone structures that stand gray against the lush green.
sentences.zh: 抬到那些在郁郁葱葱的绿色中显得灰白发暗的石质建筑上。

sentences.en: These buildings are called Towers of Silence, and this forest exists to protect them.
sentences.zh: 这些建筑被称为寂静之塔，而这片森林的存在就是为了保护它们。

sentences.en: The Towers of Silence are part of a death ritual carried out by Parsis,
sentences.zh: 寂静之塔是帕西人实行的死亡仪式的一部分，

sentences.en: a small but prosperous community in India.
sentences.zh: 帕西人是印度一个虽小但很繁荣的社群。

sentences.en: Parsis practiced Zoroastrianism, a monotheistic religion originally from Iran.
sentences.zh: 帕西人信仰祲教（琐罗亚斯德教），这是一种源自伊朗的一神教。

sentences.en: Zoroastrians in Iran were persecuted in the 7th century during the rise of the Islamic Empire,
sentences.zh: 在7世纪伊斯兰帝国崛起期间，伊朗的琐罗亚斯德教徒受到迫害，

sentences.en: and Muslim armies gave surviving Zoroastrians a choice—conversion or exile.
sentences.zh: 穆斯林军队给幸存的琐罗亚斯德教徒两个选择——改宗或流亡。

sentences.en: Eventually, a small group of Zoroastrians fled Iran for the shores of western India,
sentences.zh: 最终，一小群琐罗亚斯德教徒逃离伊朗，来到印度西海岸，

sentences.en: bringing with them any surviving fragments of tradition.
sentences.zh: 随身带来了他们所能保留的传统碎片。

sentences.en: The Parsis arrived, it is said, men, women, and children by way of one boatload.
sentences.zh: 据说，帕西人是通过一整船的男人、女人和孩子抵达这里的。

sentences.en: This is Zoroastrian religious scholar Kojeste Mistry.
sentences.zh: 这位是琐罗亚斯德教宗教学者科杰斯蒂·米斯特里。

sentences.en: He's been teaching Zoroastrian theology for the last 45 years.
sentences.zh: 他在过去45年里一直教授琐罗亚斯德教神学。

sentences.en: There's a popular legend that describes how Zoroastrians arrived in India.
sentences.zh: 有一个广为流传的传说，描述了琐罗亚斯德教徒是如何抵达印度的。

sentences.en: When this milk and sugar story began, nobody knows,
sentences.zh: 这个关于牛奶和糖的故事始于何时，无人知晓，

sentences.en: but it's the most famous story that the Parsis have been told from little children upwards.
sentences.zh: 但它是帕西人从小到大听过的最著名的故事。

sentences.en: The story goes like this.
sentences.zh: 故事是这样的。

sentences.en: When the boat full of Zoroastrians landed in India,
sentences.zh: 当载满琐罗亚斯德教徒的船只在印度登陆时，

sentences.en: the king showed them a bowl that was full to the rim with milk.
sentences.zh: 国王给他们看了一个装满牛奶直至边缘的碗。

sentences.en: Khojeste says the intention was to convey that India was already too full,
sentences.zh: 霍杰斯蒂说，其意图是传达印度已经太拥挤了，

sentences.en: no room for new arrivals.
sentences.zh: 没有新来者的容身之地。

sentences.en: And the Zoroastrian priest, the Dastur, asked for crystals of sugar,
sentences.zh: 而琐罗亚斯德教祭司达斯特要了一些糖晶体，

sentences.en: and he was given crystals of sugar,
sentences.zh: 人们给了他糖晶体，

sentences.en: and he gently lowered the crystals of sugar into this bowl full of milk,
sentences.zh: 他轻轻地将糖晶体放入这碗满溢的牛奶中，

sentences.en: and obviously the milk did not overflow from the bowl.
sentences.zh: 显而易见，牛奶并没有从碗里溢出来。

sentences.en: It suggested that not only was there room for his people in India,
sentences.zh: 这暗示着印度不仅有空间容纳他的人民，

sentences.en: but that Zoroastrians would enrich Indian society if permitted to settle.
sentences.zh: 而且如果允许定居，琐罗亚斯德教徒将丰富印度社会。

sentences.en: And the symbolism there was that the Parsis would integrate so well
sentences.zh: 其中的象征意义在于，帕西人会融入得如此之好，

sentences.en: that they would bring sweetness to the land that was giving them sanctuary.
sentences.zh: 以至于他们会为给予他们庇护的这片土地带来甜蜜。

sentences.en: From then on, Zoroastrians who settled all over India came to be known as Parsis.
sentences.zh: 从那时起，定居在印度各地的琐罗亚斯德教徒被称为帕西人。

sentences.en: Eventually, in the 1600s, Mumbai became their epicenter.
sentences.zh: 最终在17世纪（1600年代），孟买成了他们的核心区。

sentences.en: This was back when the city was still a collection of swampy, mosquito-infested islands,
sentences.zh: 那是这座城市还只是一堆沼泽密布、蚊虫滋生的岛屿的时候，

sentences.en: seemingly far enough away from the civilized world.
sentences.zh: 似乎距离文明世界足够遥远。

sentences.en: A few wealthy Parsis bought a vast expanse of land here,
sentences.zh: 一些富有的帕西人在这里买下了广阔的土地，

sentences.en: and they gave it to the community for one specific purpose.
sentences.zh: 并将其捐赠给社群，用于一个特定的目的。

sentences.en: All this land was gifted specifically for purposes of having a Tower of Silence.
sentences.zh: 所有这些土地都是专门为了建造寂静之塔而捐赠的。

sentences.en: The Towers of Silence are where Parsis placed their dead.
sentences.zh: 寂静之塔是帕西人安置逝者的地方。

sentences.en: And despite its imposing Gothic-era name that's used by Parses and non-Parses alike,
sentences.zh: 尽管它有一个帕西人和非帕西人都在使用的、气势宏大的哥特时期名称，

sentences.en: Towers of Silence aren't actually all that towering at all.
sentences.zh: 但寂静之塔实际上一点也不高耸。

sentences.en: These structures got that name by the British, who wanted an English term to describe them.
sentences.zh: 这些建筑的名字是英国人取的，他们想要一个英文词来描述它们。

sentences.en: And in doing so, they made them sound perhaps a bit more grandiose than they actually are.
sentences.zh: 这样做使它们听起来可能比实际情况更宏大一些。

sentences.en: These towers, also known simply as dachmas, are built of stone,
sentences.zh: 这些塔也被简称为达克玛，由石头建成，

sentences.en: usually up to 50 feet tall and up to about 100 feet wide.
sentences.zh: 通常高达50英尺，宽达约100英尺。

sentences.en: Imagine something more like an open-aired amphitheater.
sentences.zh: 想象一下更像露天圆形剧场的东西。

sentences.en: Each tower is circular and roofless.
sentences.zh: 每座塔都是圆形的且没有屋顶。

sentences.en: There are markers indicating where bodies should be placed.
sentences.zh: 有标记指示应该把尸体放在哪里。

sentences.en: And in the very center, there's a deep well,
sentences.zh: 而在最中心，有一个深深的井，

sentences.en: storage for the bones of Parsi bodies.
sentences.zh: 用于存放帕西人遗骸的骨头。

sentences.en: Wherever large clusters of Parsi settled,
sentences.zh: 无论帕西人在哪里大量定居，

sentences.en: they would cultivate forests, or dungravadis,
sentences.zh: 他们都会开垦森林（即邓格拉瓦迪），

sentences.en: and build dakmas inside them.
sentences.zh: 并在其中建造达克玛。

sentences.en: Five dhakmas were built here in Mumbai,
sentences.zh: 这里在孟买建造了五座达克玛，

sentences.en: which in total are able to handle over a thousand corpses a year.
sentences.zh: 总共每年能够处理一千多具尸体。

sentences.en: Zoroastrians have practiced this ritual of sky burial in Mumbai for centuries.
sentences.zh: 几个世纪以来，琐罗亚斯德教徒一直在孟买实行这种天葬仪式。

sentences.en: According to the faith, as soon as we die, our bodies become contaminated with evil.
sentences.zh: 根据信仰，我们一死，尸体就会被邪恶污染。

sentences.en: And this evil must not, under any circumstance,
sentences.zh: 而这种邪恶在任何情况下都绝对不能

sentences.en: make contact with the sacred elements of fire, water, and earth.
sentences.zh: 与火、水和土这神圣的元素接触。

sentences.en: Therefore, we cannot bury our dead because that's polluting Mother Earth.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们不能土葬逝者，因为那是污染大地母亲。

sentences.en: We cannot burn our dead because that's polluting fire, and fire is seen as the Son of God.
sentences.zh: 我们不能火化逝者，因为那是污染火，而火被视为上帝之子。

sentences.en: So Zoroastrians have always had this unusual method of giving back to nature.
sentences.zh: 因此，琐罗亚斯德教徒一直采用这种不同寻常的回馈自然的方法。

sentences.en: By giving back to nature, what Kojeste means is that after priests have said their final prayers,
sentences.zh: 科杰斯蒂所说的回馈自然，是指在祭司念完最后的祈祷后，

sentences.en: the corpse bearers will place a body atop one of these towers.
sentences.zh: 抬棺人会将尸体放置在其中一座塔的顶端。

sentences.en: Then they will wait for the vultures to come.
sentences.zh: 然后他们会等待秃鹰的到来。

sentences.en: Rashne Bhardiwala grew up in a Parsi family,
sentences.zh: 拉什内·巴尔迪瓦拉在一个帕西家庭长大，

sentences.en: minutes from the Mumbai Dungarwadi forest where the towers of silence stand.
sentences.zh: 距离耸立着寂静之塔的孟买邓格拉瓦迪森林只有几分钟路程。

sentences.en: She remembers the first time she learned about the vultures
sentences.zh: 她还记得她第一次得知秃鹰

sentences.en: and their role in consuming Parsi corpses.
sentences.zh: 以及它们在吞食帕西人尸体中的作用时的情景。

sentences.en: We were on a family holiday in Gujarat and we were driving.
sentences.zh: 我们当时在古吉拉特邦进行家庭度假，正在开车。

sentences.en: And I must have been all of possibly five or six years old.
sentences.zh: 我当时大概也就五六岁吧。

sentences.en: Out of their car window,
sentences.zh: 透过车窗，

sentences.en: Rushna's family saw a dead horse on the roadside.
sentences.zh: 拉什娜的家人看到路边有一匹死马。

sentences.en: They pulled over out of curiosity
sentences.zh: 出于好奇，他们把车停在路边，

sentences.en: just to take a closer look.
sentences.zh: 只是想仔细看一看。

sentences.en: Rushna remembers her father pointing to the sky in awe.
sentences.zh: 拉什娜记得她父亲敬畏地指向天空。

sentences.en: He said, oh, look, those are the birds,
sentences.zh: 他说，哦，看，那是那些鸟，

sentences.en: those are vultures up there circling.
sentences.zh: 上面盘旋的那些是秃鹰。

sentences.en: And then thought nothing of it,
sentences.zh: 然后就没当回事，

sentences.en: got back into the car, and we drove off.
sentences.zh: 重新上了车，我们开走了。

sentences.en: 20 or so minutes later,
sentences.zh: 大约20分钟后，

sentences.en: Rushna and her family drove back down that same road.
sentences.zh: 拉什娜和家人开车沿原路返回。

sentences.en: And that is when all of us were absolutely shocked.
sentences.zh: 就在那时，我们所有人都震惊了。

sentences.en: And I remember Dad just slamming on the brakes and stopping
sentences.zh: 我记得爸爸猛踩刹车停了下来，

sentences.en: because a horse that we had seen dead 15, 20 minutes ago
sentences.zh: 因为我们在15、20分钟前看到的死马，

sentences.en: had been completely wiped clean by the vultures.
sentences.zh: 已经被秃鹰啃得精光。

sentences.en: In 15 minutes, that carcass was cleaned down to the bone.
sentences.zh: 在15分钟内，那具尸体就被清理得只剩骨头。

sentences.en: A few vultures were actually still sitting there, perched right next to the skeleton,
sentences.zh: 事实上，还有几只秃鹰仍然坐在那里，栖息在骨架旁，

sentences.en: their bellies too heavy with horse meat to fly.
sentences.zh: 它们的肚子吃马肉吃得太饱而飞不动了。

sentences.en: But to Rushna's family, the scene wasn't grim.
sentences.zh: 但在拉什娜的家人看来，这个场景并不严酷。

sentences.en: And I remember my mother using that opportunity as a learning, saying,
sentences.zh: 我记得母亲借此机会上了一课，说道：

sentences.en: oh, you know, this is why they say our mode of disposal of the dead in the Parsi community is the best mode,
sentences.zh: 哦，你知道，这就是为什么他们说我们帕西社群处理死者的方式是最好的方式，

sentences.en: because it's such a quick, clean, efficient system.
sentences.zh: 因为它是一个如此迅速、干净、高效的系统。

sentences.en: This interdependent system between Zoroastrians
sentences.zh: 琐罗亚斯德教徒

sentences.en: and the birds who consume the flesh of their dead,
sentences.zh: 与食用他们死者血肉的鸟类之间的这种相互依存系统，

sentences.en: it's called dhokmenashini, and it is ancient.
sentences.zh: 被称为多克梅纳希尼（dhokmenashini），这是一个古老的传统。

sentences.en: The relationship between vultures and the Parsis,
sentences.zh: 秃鹰与帕西人之间的关系，

sentences.en: it goes back thousands of years.
sentences.zh: 可以追溯到数千年前。

sentences.en: This is writer Mira Subramanian,
sentences.zh: 这位是作家米拉·苏布拉曼尼亚姆，

sentences.en: who has written at length about vultures in South Asia.
sentences.zh: 她曾大量撰写关于南亚秃鹰的文章。

sentences.en: She says that, according to some estimates,
sentences.zh: 她说，据某些估计，

sentences.en: there were once well over 40 million vultures throughout India.
sentences.zh: 印度曾一度拥有远超4000万只秃鹰。

sentences.en: But no one will ever really know.
sentences.zh: 但没有人能真正确切知道。

sentences.en: They were so plentiful, in fact,
sentences.zh: 事实上，它们数量如此之多，

sentences.en: that no scientific efforts were ever made to do a population count.
sentences.zh: 以至于从未开展过任何科学的人口普查工作。

sentences.en: For kids growing up in India, my own parents included,
sentences.zh: 对于在印度长大的孩子来说，包括我自己的父母在内，

sentences.en: there were far less dogs supposedly eating homework
sentences.zh: 可以说是狗吃作业的情况要少得多，

sentences.en: and many more vultures to blame in the classroom instead.
sentences.zh: 而更多时候是在教室里把责任怪到秃鹰头上。

sentences.en: As in, sorry I'm late to school,
sentences.zh: 就像是，抱歉我上学迟到了，

sentences.en: vultures were mid-feet on a roadside carcass, blocking traffic again.
sentences.zh: 因为秃鹰正在路边尸体上用餐，又把交通堵住了。

sentences.en: India's Civil Aviation Department would even hire people to shoot vultures around airports
sentences.zh: 印度的民航部门甚至会雇人射杀机场周围的秃鹰，

sentences.en: because they posed such a hazard to air traffic.
sentences.zh: 因为它们对空中交通构成了巨大的危险。

sentences.en: You know, they were just always there.
sentences.zh: 你知道，它们就一直都在那儿。

sentences.en: They were always there, and there were so many of them.
sentences.zh: 它们一直都在那儿，而且数量庞大。

sentences.en: In this story, we're mostly referring to a genus of vultures called gyps vultures.
sentences.zh: 在这个故事中，我们主要指的是一类被称为兀鹫的秃鹰。

sentences.en: And these birds, they just have this look about them.
sentences.zh: 这些鸟类，它们的外表就是那种样子。

sentences.en: They look, you know, not the beSt.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，它们看起来算不上最好看。

sentences.en: I won't say ugly, but they don't look very attractive as a bird.
sentences.zh: 我不会说它们丑，但作为鸟类，它们确实算不上好看。

sentences.en: In the sky, vultures loom large, casting an eight-foot shadow with their massive wingspan.
sentences.zh: 在天空中，秃鹫若隐若现，它们巨大的翼展投下八英尺宽的阴影。

sentences.en: And on the ground, sometimes you can only see their bodies,
sentences.zh: 而在地面上，有时你只能看到它们的身体，

sentences.en: their bald heads often buried deep inside a fresh carcass.

sentences.en: While vultures are scavengers often associated with greediness and death, they're actually very shy around people.
sentences.zh: 虽然秃鹫是常与贪婪和死亡联系在一起的食腐动物，但它们在人类面前其实非常害羞。

sentences.en: These are birds that just they don't they don't like interacting with humans.

sentences.en: Like the most common response if they are disturbed by humans is that they vomit and they fly away.
sentences.zh: 比如，如果它们受到人类干扰，最常见的反应就是呕吐然后飞走。

sentences.en: And yet, for centuries, a very specific symbiosis played out here in Mumbai,
sentences.zh: 然而，几个世纪以来，孟买这里一直在上演一种非常奇特的共生关系，

sentences.zh: 发生在这群秃鹫、这片森林和帕尔西人之间。

sentences.en: Time passed, wars came and went, cities grew, trees fell.
sentences.zh: 岁月流逝，战争来来去去，城市扩张，树木倒下。

sentences.en: But this practice survived.
sentences.zh: 但这种习俗存活了下来。

sentences.en: In Mumbai, approximately three new bodies were carried up every day.
sentences.zh: 在孟买，平均每天大约有三具新的遗体被抬上去。

sentences.en: It was an efficient send-off, one in which your body became your final offering to the natural world.

sentences.en: Most of all, it was tradition.

sentences.en: I met Aspi a few hours north of Mumbai, in a small town with a large Parsi population.
sentences.zh: 我在孟买以北数小时车程的一个帕尔西人口众多的刺绣小镇上遇到了阿斯皮。

sentences.en: Aspi wore a bright pink and orange blouse that he had hand-sewn,

sentences.en: For more than four decades, Aspi has done the work that goes by many names,
sentences.zh: 四十多年来，阿斯皮一直从事着这份有许多名称的工作，

sentences.en: the work that takes him deep into the Dungravadi forest, where few others can go.
sentences.zh: 这项工作将他带入了极少有人能涉足的东格拉瓦迪森林深处。

sentences.en: In Gujarati, Aspi describes it as the work of giving shoulder,
sentences.zh: 用古吉拉特语来说，阿斯皮将其描述为“借出肩膀”的工作，

sentences.en: because a large part of his work involves carrying bodies of the deceased on his shoulders.
sentences.zh: 因为他很大一部分工作涉及用肩膀抬运逝者的遗体。

sentences.zh: 但那些从事抬尸人工作的人往往只被人在私下里低声议论。

sentences.en: Many Khandiyas live right on Dungarvadi grounds.
sentences.zh: 许多坎迪亚人就住在东格拉瓦迪的土地上。

sentences.en: And because in Zoroastrianism,

sentences.zh: 有时，阿斯皮和他的同行抬尸人必须用铁棒赶走秃鹫，直到所有的仪式都完成。

sentences.en: And once the body is placed inside, they pounce and eat.

sentences.zh: 迪恩沙几乎永远耸着肩膀，解释了关于

sentences.en: conversion and intermarriage, the trend of fewer Parsis having children.
sentences.zh: 通婚和皈依的严格规定，以及生育后代的帕西人越来越少的趋势。

sentences.en: Their population has been shrinking too, alongside the vultures.
sentences.zh: 随着秃鹫的消失，他们的人口也在不断萎缩。

sentences.en: You know how sometimes there'll be a word in the English language that seems simple but has just a stupid amount of different meanings?
sentences.zh: 你知道有时候英语里会有一个词，看起来很简单，但却有着荒谬之多的不同意思吗？

sentences.en: I've been thinking a lot about this one particular word.
sentences.zh: 我一直在思考这个特定的词。

sentences.en: Wake.
sentences.zh: 醒来。

sentences.en: As in W-A-K-E.
sentences.zh: 也就是 W-A-K-E。

sentences.en: Wake.
sentences.zh: 醒来。

sentences.en: And yes, I was a spelling bee kid who was made to spell this word.
sentences.zh: 是的，我以前是个拼字比赛小孩，被人要求拼过这个词。

sentences.en: And yes, I will give you a definition.
sentences.zh: 是的，我来给你们下一个定义。

sentences.en: To wake from something can mean to make a realization or discovery
sentences.zh: 从某种状态中wake，可以指在经历了一段时间的睡眠或无知之后，

sentences.en: after a period of being asleep or unaware.
sentences.zh: 有所领悟或发现。

sentences.en: Awake is also a vigil for someone who has just died,
sentences.zh: Awake也是为刚去世的人守灵，

sentences.en: a form of honoring or celebrating the life of the deceased.
sentences.zh: 一种纪念或庆祝逝者一生的形式。

sentences.en: And awake, it also happens to be the collective noun
sentences.zh: 而awake，恰好也是用来形容

sentences.en: for a group of vultures who are mid-feet on a corpse.
sentences.zh: 一群正在尸体上大快朵颐的秃鹫的集合名词。

sentences.en: Back in Mumbai, Vinshah still needed to make a plan.
sentences.zh: 回到孟买，温沙仍然需要制定一个计划。

sentences.en: By this point, by the way, it's 2001.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一下，到这个时候已经是2001年了，

sentences.en: and there are two clusters of tall apartment buildings peering over Dungarwadi.
sentences.zh: 有两群高层公寓楼俯瞰着敦加瓦迪。

sentences.en: Some towers were going unused at the time,
sentences.zh: 当时有些塔楼处于闲置状态，

sentences.en: and they wanted to figure out if people were getting a view of those towers too.
sentences.zh: 他们想弄清楚人们是否也能从窗户看到那些塔楼。

sentences.en: So Dinsha laid down on each stone slab of the empty towers,
sentences.zh: 于是迪恩沙躺在空置塔楼的每一块石板上，

sentences.en: and he asked residents on the top floors of the surrounding apartment buildings if they could see him.
sentences.zh: 并问周围公寓楼顶层的居民是否能看到他。

sentences.en: So basically you were on the phone while laying down on one of these slabs,
sentences.zh: 所以基本上你是一边躺在其中一块石板上打电话，

sentences.en: and somebody else was as well.
sentences.zh: 而另一个人也在这样做，

sentences.en: and your friend would tell you,
sentences.zh: 然后你的朋友会告诉你，

sentences.en: oh, no, I can see you.
sentences.zh: 哦，不，我能看到你。

sentences.en: Wow, so it really factored into your decision-making in a big way.
sentences.zh: 哇，所以这确实在很大程度上影响了你们的决策。

sentences.en: One of the few living Parsis who had slept on the slab.
sentences.zh: 少数几个睡过石板的在世帕西人之一。

sentences.en: Wow, that's pretty funny.
sentences.zh: 哇，这挺搞笑的。

sentences.en: Ultimately, Dinshaw found that two of the five towers at Dungarwadi
sentences.zh: 最终，迪恩沙发现敦加瓦迪的五座塔楼中有两座

sentences.en: could be seen from apartment windows.
sentences.zh: 可以从公寓的窗户看到。

sentences.en: As a result, they stopped using those two towers.
sentences.zh: 因此，他们停止使用这两座塔楼。

sentences.en: Atop the remaining towers, the panchayat, the Parsi leadership council,
sentences.zh: 在其余的塔楼顶上，帕查亚特（即帕西人领导委员会）

sentences.en: agreed to begin conducting a series of experiments.
sentences.zh: 同意开始进行一系列实验。

sentences.en: Their goal was to find a way to speed up decomposition,
sentences.zh: 他们的目标是找到一种方法来加速分解，

sentences.en: or at the very least, to hide the view and smell of the rotting bodies.
sentences.zh: 或者至少掩盖腐烂尸体的视线和气味。

sentences.en: First, they tried lining the outer rim of the towers
sentences.zh: 首先，他们尝试在塔楼的外缘

sentences.en: with a particular flower called kevra that smells thick and perfumey.
sentences.zh: 铺上一层名为克夫拉（kevra）的特殊花朵，这种花气味浓烈，带有香气。

sentences.en: If you have earthen pots outside the walls and put in that flour and add water,
sentences.zh: 如果你在墙外放上陶罐，把那种花粉放进去并加水，

sentences.en: it will give out a very pungent smell, which will mask the smell.
sentences.zh: 它就会散发出一种非常刺鼻的气味，从而掩盖臭味。

sentences.en: But it wasn't doing quite enough.
sentences.zh: 但这还远远不够。

sentences.en: Then there was brief excitement about a special mixture of herbs and chemicals.
sentences.zh: 然后，人们对一种由草药和化学物质组成的特殊混合物产生过短暂的兴奋。

sentences.en: The idea being that when stuffed into orifices of the dead,
sentences.zh: 其想法是，当塞进死者的各个孔窍时，

sentences.en: maybe this mixture could speed up decomposition
sentences.zh: 这种混合物也许能在腐肉的气味散发出来之前，

sentences.en: before the smell of rotting flesh kicks in.
sentences.zh: 加速分解过程。

sentences.en: It accelerated the process of decomposition.
sentences.zh: 它确实加速了分解过程。

sentences.en: But it had a counter effect.
sentences.zh: 但它带来了相反的效果。

sentences.en: The whole area inside became very sludgy.
sentences.zh: 里面整个区域变得黏糊糊的。

sentences.en: The chemicals were almost too effective.
sentences.zh: 这些化学物质的效力简直太强了。

sentences.en: The floor atop the towers became a kind of human slurry.
sentences.zh: 塔楼顶部的地板变成了一种人类残渣般的浆液。

sentences.en: And a couple of pallbearers slipped, fell into the central well.
sentences.zh: 几个抬尸人滑倒了，掉进了中央的井里。

sentences.en: They had to be brought out.
sentences.zh: 他们不得不被救出来。

sentences.en: The pallbearers had trouble moving the bodies.
sentences.zh: 抬尸人在搬运尸体时遇到了困难。

sentences.en: And the worst thing was the pallbearers refused to use this composition
sentences.zh: 最糟糕的是，抬尸人拒绝使用这种混合配方，

sentences.en: because they said that when they lift the bodies to put them in the central well,
sentences.zh: 因为他们说，当他们抬起尸体把它们放进中央井时，

sentences.en: it was a very messy thing.
sentences.zh: 情况变得非常糟糕混乱。

sentences.en: The arms would come out, the legs would come out that way.
sentences.zh: 胳膊会脱落，腿也会那样散开。

sentences.en: From behind closed doors at weekly panchayat board meetings
sentences.zh: 在每周帕查亚特董事会闭门会议的幕后

sentences.en: and on the forums of community newspapers,
sentences.zh: 以及社区报纸的论坛上，

sentences.en: Parsis discussed any possible solutions they could think of.
sentences.zh: 帕西人讨论了他们能想到的任何可能的解决方案。

sentences.en: Parsis living in diaspora all over the world started to write in with suggestions.
sentences.zh: 世界各地侨居的帕西人开始写信提出建议。

sentences.en: There was so much internal dialogue going on within the Parsi community.
sentences.zh: 帕西社区内部进行了如此多的内部对话。

sentences.en: The Orthodox ones who said, no, this is the only way we can dispose of the dead.
sentences.zh: 那些正统派说，不，这是处理死者的唯一方法。

sentences.en: Those who were pro-adaptation, who already acknowledged that Parsis were all over the world and were not doing sky burials.
sentences.zh: 那些支持适应变革的人，他们已经承认帕西人遍布世界各地，并没有实行天葬。

sentences.en: And so many of the diaspora that was all over the place, if they weren't in Mumbai, where the towers were.
sentences.zh: 还有许多四处分散的海外侨民，如果他们不在有塔楼的孟买的话。

sentences.en: So all these questions came up about adaptation and survival.
sentences.zh: 因此，所有关于适应和生存的问题都涌现出来了。

sentences.en: Some suggested they use gasification, which involves high heat, or promession,
sentences.zh: 有人建议他们使用涉及高温的气化技术，或是冰葬，

sentences.en: a technique in Sweden that uses liquid nitrogen to deep freeze a body before vibrating it into a fine powder.
sentences.zh: 这是一种在瑞典使用的技术，用液氮将尸体深度冷冻，然后将其振动成细粉。

sentences.en: One entomologist in Germany suggested they try flesh-eating insects.
sentences.zh: 德国的一位昆虫学家建议他们尝试食肉昆虫。

sentences.en: But no one could agree on any one solution.
sentences.zh: 但没有人能就任何单一解决方案达成一致。

sentences.en: Nothing compared to the efficiency, cleanliness, and theological alignment of the vultures.
sentences.zh: 没有什么能比得上秃鹫的效率、洁净度和神学契合度。

sentences.en: Eventually, though, the Bombay Parsi Panchayat landed on a plan.
sentences.zh: 不过，最终孟买帕西人帕查亚特敲定了一个计划。

sentences.en: They would install solar panels on the towers.
sentences.zh: 他们将在塔楼上安装太阳能电池板。

sentences.en: Solar panels, or solar concentrators as they're often called, would essentially look like giant mirrors.
sentences.zh: 太阳能电池板，或者通常被称为太阳能聚光器，本质上看起来就像巨大的镜子。

sentences.en: Aspi Gadiyali remembers working as a corpse-bearer during this transition.
sentences.zh: 阿斯皮·加迪亚利回忆起在这次过渡期间担任抬尸人的经历。

sentences.en: The rays of the sun fall on the mirror, and then they reflect back to the body.
sentences.zh: 太阳光线照射在镜子上，然后反射回尸体上。

sentences.en: So when the heat of the sun falls on the body, the body melts.
sentences.zh: 因此，当太阳的热量落在尸体上时，尸体就会融化。

sentences.en: You know, like how you put the butter in a frying pan to make pav bhaji.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，就像你在平底锅里放黄油来做帕夫巴吉一样。

sentences.en: The butter melts, and this is how the body diffuses.
sentences.zh: 黄油融化了，尸体就是这样消解的。

sentences.en: The Panchayat hoped that the solar panels would speed up decomposition
sentences.zh: 帕查亚特希望太阳能电池板能够加速分解，

sentences.en: without involving contact with fire, water, or earth, Perserastrian tradition.
sentences.zh: 而又不会触及祆教传统中涉及火、水或土的忌讳。

sentences.en: Solar panels were installed first in Mumbai's Dungravadi
sentences.zh: 太阳能电池板首先安装在孟买的敦加瓦迪，

sentences.en: and then atop towers of silence all over India.
sentences.zh: 随后又安装在印度各地的寂静塔顶部。

sentences.en: It might sound gruesome, but bodies melting or dehydrating is far better than just rotting.
sentences.zh: 这听起来可能很可怕，但尸体融化或脱水远比单纯腐烂要好得多。

sentences.en: And although some had misgivings about the change, calling it backdoor cremation,
sentences.zh: 尽管有些人对这一改变心存疑虑，称其为变相火葬，

sentences.en: it mostly seemed like a massive relief that some sort of a solution had finally been found,
sentences.zh: 但能够终于找到某种解决方案，总算让人感到卸下了沉重的负担，

sentences.en: instead of leaving a body to rot for months.
sentences.zh: 总比任由尸体腐烂几个月要好。

sentences.en: The solar concentrators felt like a collective exhale,
sentences.zh: 太阳能聚光器让人感觉像是一次集体的吐气放松，

sentences.en: a triumph of human engineering, a cause for celebration.
sentences.zh: 是人类工程学的胜利，值得庆祝。

sentences.en: But all that changed when one woman's grief and rage
sentences.zh: 但这一切都在一个女人的悲伤与愤怒

sentences.en: propelled the Parsi community into a new level of reckoning.
sentences.zh: 推动帕西社区进入全新反思阶段时发生了改变。

sentences.en: And then five years later, Dhan Bariya comes into the picture.
sentences.zh: 五年后，丹·巴里亚进入了人们的视野。

sentences.en: And turns the world around, topsy-turvy.
sentences.zh: 并且把世界搅得天翻地覆。

sentences.en: We'll be back after this.
sentences.zh: 广告之后马上回来。

sentences.en: We're back with producer Lasha Madan.
sentences.zh: 欢迎回来，我们请到了制作人拉莎·马丹。

sentences.en: In 2005, four years after construction began on the solar panels,
sentences.zh: 2005年，即太阳能电池板开始施工四年后，

sentences.en: a Parsi woman named Dhan Bariya laid her 85-year-old mother, Nargis Bariya,
sentences.zh: 一位名叫丹·巴里亚的帕西女性将她85岁的母亲纳吉斯·巴里亚

sentences.en: to rest at the Mumbai Dungarwadi.
sentences.zh: 安葬在孟买的敦加瓦迪。

sentences.en: Dhan had cut short her career as a touring folk singer
sentences.zh: 丹为了照顾卧床不起的母亲，

sentences.en: to look after her bedridden mother,
sentences.zh: 中断了她作为巡回民谣歌手的职业生涯，

sentences.en: whom she had lived with for 56 years.
sentences.zh: 她和母亲一起生活了56年。

sentences.en: After her mom died, Dhan felt lonely and utterly bereft,
sentences.zh: 母亲去世后，丹感到孤独和彻底的失落，

sentences.en: and she took to spending long hours at Dungravadi, praying.
sentences.zh: 她开始花很长时间在敦加瓦迪祈祷。

sentences.en: Dhan was a very pious, devote type of...
sentences.zh: 丹是一个非常虔诚、笃信宗教的人……

sentences.en: She used to pray every day from the book, etc.
sentences.zh: 她过去常常每天对照经书等进行祈祷。

sentences.en: And she used to go quite often to the Dungarwai to pray before the tower in which her mother was consigned.
sentences.zh: 她经常去敦加瓦迪，在她母亲被安放的塔前祈祷。

sentences.en: On her visits, Dan would make small talk with the staff.
sentences.zh: 在拜访期间，丹会和工作人员闲聊。

sentences.en: One afternoon, almost a year after her mother's death, Dan had an unusual interaction with one of the khandiyas on duty.
sentences.zh: 一天下午，在她母亲去世近一年后，丹与一位当班的抬尸人有了一次不同寻常的互动。

sentences.en: She was going back to the towers to pay her respects and do her prayers.
sentences.zh: 她正要回塔楼去表达敬意并做祈祷。

sentences.en: And, you know, she just asked the khandiyas, like, oh, so my mother's gone, right?
sentences.zh: 然后，你知道的，她只是随口问了抬尸人，哦，所以我母亲已经不在了，对吧？

sentences.en: And they're like, ha, no, she's still up there.
sentences.zh: 而他们却说，哈，没有，她还在上面呢。

sentences.en: There's no vultures.
sentences.zh: 没有秃鹫了。

sentences.en: Where would she go?
sentences.zh: 她能去哪儿？

sentences.en: And they sniggled at her.
sentences.zh: 他们向她窃笑，

sentences.en: And they laughed and they said, your mom is still inside.
sentences.zh: 笑着说，你妈妈还在里面。

sentences.en: If you want to, we can show you.
sentences.zh: 如果你想看，我们可以带你看。

sentences.en: So that was the trigger for her.
sentences.zh: 所以这就是她的导火索。

sentences.en: Like everyone else, Dunn knew that the vultures were gone.
sentences.zh: 和所有人一样，丹知道秃鹫已经消失了。

sentences.en: But she believed, like most in her community,
sentences.zh: 但她和社区里的大多数人一样坚信，

sentences.en: that the solar panel technology had fully decomposed her mother's body.
sentences.zh: 太阳能电池板技术已经完全分解了她母亲的遗体。

sentences.en: And she was understandably horrified,
sentences.zh: 可以理解的是，她感到惊恐万分，

sentences.en: thinking about her mother naked up on top of this tower, slowly rotting.
sentences.zh: 想着她那赤裸的母亲躺在这个塔顶上，慢慢地腐烂。

sentences.en: Dunn wasn't just thinking about her mother.
sentences.zh: 邓恩不只是在想她的母亲。

sentences.en: She was thinking about all the mothers.
sentences.zh: 她是在想所有的母亲。

sentences.en: She wasn't a person to just sit on her heels and complain about something
sentences.zh: 她可不是那种只会袖手旁观、满腹牢骚的人

sentences.en: or stew about it or write a nice letter of complaint.
sentences.zh: 或者为此生闷气，又或者写一封客气的投诉信。

sentences.en: That just wasn't her style.
sentences.zh: 这绝不是她的风格。

sentences.en: Dunn wanted the Parsi community to know that these solar panels
sentences.zh: 邓恩想让帕西社群知道，这些太阳能电池板

sentences.en: weren't working as well as people thought they were,
sentences.zh: 根本没有人们想象的那么管用，

sentences.en: especially during India's four-month-long monsoon season,
sentences.zh: 特别是在印度长达四个月的季风季节里，

sentences.en: when there isn't enough sunlight for the solar panels to really work.
sentences.zh: 当时阳光根本不够，太阳能电池板无法正常运转。

sentences.en: Dunn wanted to tell people that their deceased loved ones were decomposing,
sentences.zh: 邓恩想告诉大家，他们死去的亲人在慢慢地

sentences.en: slowly, that their souls weren't free.
sentences.zh: 腐烂，他们的灵魂无法得到解脱。

sentences.en: Photographs from inside the Towers of Silence,
sentences.zh: 寂静之塔内部的照片，

sentences.en: where the Parsi community in Mumbai disposes of its debt.
sentences.zh: 孟买的帕西社群就是在这里处理他们的亡者。

sentences.en: These forbidden photographs are creating big ripples in the small community.
sentences.zh: 这些禁忌的照片在这个小社群里掀起了轩然大波。

sentences.en: This is from an old CNN report.
sentences.zh: 这段录像摘自早期的美国有线电视新闻网报道。

sentences.en: Dhan had hired a photographer to sneak into the Towers of Silence
sentences.zh: 达恩曾雇了一名摄影师潜入寂静之塔

sentences.en: and capture images of the decomposing bodies.
sentences.zh: 拍下了尸体腐烂的照片。

sentences.en: 65-year-old Dhan Baria consigned her mother to the towers almost a year ago,
sentences.zh: 65岁的达恩·巴里亚将她的母亲送入塔内差不多有一年了，

sentences.en: so she was shocked to hear from insiders that the body was still rotting slowly.
sentences.zh: 所以当她从内部人士那里听说尸体仍在慢慢腐烂时，她感到震惊。

sentences.en: Years earlier, photos had been taken from a faraway telescopic lens
sentences.zh: 多年前，人们曾用远距离长焦镜头拍过照片，

sentences.en: and sent privately to Dinsha and the rest of the Panchayat.
sentences.zh: 并私下发给了丁沙和潘查亚特的其他人。

sentences.en: This time, though, Dhan wanted to get photos from up close,
sentences.zh: 不过这一次，达恩想要拍到近距离的照片，

sentences.en: and she wanted to go public with them.
sentences.zh: 而且她想把这些照片公之于众。

sentences.en: Everything was about to go up a notch.
sentences.zh: 一切都即将升级。

sentences.en: Awful images made the rounds,
sentences.zh: 可怕的照片开始流传，

sentences.en: on flyers slipped under doors and into mailboxes.
sentences.zh: 被塞在门缝里和投进信箱的传单上。

sentences.en: A 15-minute video circulating online
sentences.zh: 一段在网上流传的15分钟视频

sentences.en: showed bodies in various stages of decomposition.
sentences.zh: 展示了处于不同腐烂阶段的尸体。

sentences.en: Images of loved ones with their eyes hollowed out,
sentences.zh: 画面中，亲人们的眼眶空洞，

sentences.en: their mouths gaping at the sky.

sentences.zh: 帕查亚特的计划遭到了相当大的担忧和顾虑。

sentences.en: All this made it hard to reach consensus on the aviary project.
sentences.zh: 所有这些使得人们很难就饲养场项目达成共识。

sentences.en: So, ultimately, Kojeste's plan fizzled out.
sentences.zh: 因此，最终科杰斯特的计划不了了之。

sentences.en: The aviary project died in natural death.
sentences.zh: 饲养场项目自然夭折了。

sentences.en: How does it feel to have tried so hard and the vultures are not back?
sentences.zh: 付出了这么大努力却没有迎来秃鹫归来，你现在是什么感觉？

sentences.en: My time to go to Dungarwaji is also coming round.
sentences.zh: 我前往登加瓦迪的日子也快到了。

sentences.en: You know, you begin to think about mortality as you get older, Lasha.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，拉沙，随着年龄的增长，你会开始思考生死问题。

sentences.en: It's certainly something one thinks about.
sentences.zh: 这确实是人们会思考的事情。

sentences.en: Now, as far as I'm concerned, when I die,
sentences.zh: 现在，就我个人而言，当我死去时，

sentences.en: certainly I'll be able to meet Morbid Hormuz upstairs
sentences.zh: 我肯定能在精神世界的上层见到莫比德·霍尔穆兹

sentences.en: in the spiritual world and say, I did my beSt.
sentences.zh: 并对他说，我已经尽力了。

sentences.en: Despite the very obvious logistical barriers,
sentences.zh: 尽管存在非常明显的后勤障碍，

sentences.en: every couple years, it seems that the idea for an aviary
sentences.zh: 但似乎每隔几年，建立饲养场的想法

sentences.en: resurfaces with new fervor.
sentences.zh: 就会以新的热情重新浮现。

sentences.en: The latest article is from just a few months ago,
sentences.zh: 最近的一篇文章就在几个月前，

sentences.en: January 2024, announcing a new plan
sentences.zh: 即2024年1月，宣布了一项新计划

sentences.en: to build a vulture aviary atop the towers.
sentences.zh: 要在塔楼之巅建造一个秃鹫饲养场。

sentences.en: This time, though, it's not Kojeste spearheading.
sentences.zh: 不过这一次，牵头的人不再是科杰斯特。

sentences.en: His time on the panchayat ended almost a decade ago.
sentences.zh: 他在委员会任职的时期已将近十年前就结束了。

sentences.en: A few months ago, I traveled with Dinshaw to a Dungravadi in another town,
sentences.zh: 几个月前，我和迪恩肖一起去了另一个城镇的登加瓦迪，

sentences.en: far from the tension that's mostly centered around the main Dungravadi in Mumbai.
sentences.zh: 那里远离主要围绕孟买主登加瓦迪的紧张氛围。

sentences.en: It was lush and peaceful.
sentences.zh: 这里郁郁葱葱，宁静祥和。

sentences.en: I was allowed to approach the base of one of the towers,
sentences.zh: 我得以走近其中一座塔楼的底部，

sentences.en: and when I craned my neck, I could see one of the solar panels hovering above the rim,
sentences.zh: 当我伸长脖子时，我看到一块太阳能电池板悬浮在边缘上方，

sentences.en: held up by what looked like a long telephone pole.
sentences.zh: 由一个看起来像长电线杆的东西支撑着。

sentences.en: Despite the fact that Dunn exposed the shortcomings of the solar concentrators,
sentences.zh: 尽管邓恩揭露了太阳能聚光器的缺点，

sentences.en: this is the method still in use atop the towers today.
sentences.zh: 但直到今天，塔楼顶端仍在采用这种方法。

sentences.en: The solar panels were small and uninspiring,
sentences.zh: 这些太阳能电池板又小又不起眼，

sentences.en: nothing like what I'd imagined.
sentences.zh: 一点也不像我想象的那样。

sentences.en: Most of all, they were broken.
sentences.zh: 最重要的是，它们坏了。

sentences.en: The mirrored glass was completely shattered,
sentences.zh: 镜面玻璃完全碎裂了，

sentences.en: leaving the panels useless.
sentences.zh: 这使得电池板失去了作用。

sentences.en: There was this amazing moment when I saw the culprit,
sentences.zh: 当时有一个奇妙的时刻，我看到了罪魁祸首，

sentences.en: a peacock, flying up to the one intact mirror and pecking at the glass.
sentences.zh: 一只孔雀飞到那面完好无损的镜子前，用嘴啄着玻璃。

sentences.en: Oh my God.
sentences.zh: 噢我的天呐。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: So they really do climb up to the towers.
sentences.zh: 所以它们真的会爬到塔楼上去。

sentences.en: That's amazing.
sentences.zh: 太神奇了。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So there's a peacock and it climbed onto the solar panel right in front of us.
sentences.zh: 所以有一只孔雀，它就在我们面前爬上了太阳能电池板。

sentences.en: It's looking at its reflection and pecking its peak into the glass.
sentences.zh: 它看着自己的倒影，把喙啄向玻璃。

sentences.en: Have you heard of the Mumbai dhundurwadi ever having a peacock problem?
sentences.zh: 你听说过孟买的登加瓦迪曾经遇到过孔雀的问题吗？

sentences.en: Plenty.
sentences.zh: 很多。

sentences.en: Yeah?
sentences.zh: 是吗？

sentences.en: Plenty.
sentences.zh: 很多。

sentences.en: Imagine putting so much effort into finding a solution,
sentences.zh: 试想一下，花这么大功夫寻找解决方案，

sentences.en: only to have a different type of bird come in and mess it up.
sentences.zh: 结果却来了一种不同种类的鸟把事情搞砸了。

sentences.en: The solar panels had once felt like a viable alternative
sentences.zh: 太阳能电池板曾一度被认为是一种可行的替代方案，

sentences.en: to dispose of the dead in the absence of vultures.
sentences.zh: 用于在没有秃鹫的情况下处理遗体。

sentences.en: But now you have peacocks pecking at the remains of this failed experiment.
sentences.zh: 但现在却有孔雀在啄食这个失败实验的残骸。

sentences.en: And for corpse bearers, who already face precarious labor conditions and low wages,
sentences.zh: 对于那些本就面临不稳定劳动条件和低工资的遗体抬送员来说，

sentences.en: they sometimes need to drag a body around multiple times to keep relocating the solar panels on different body parts in order for the corpse to fully decompose.
sentences.zh: 他们有时需要多次拖拽遗体，以便将太阳能电池板重新放置在遗体的不同部位，从而使尸体完全分解。

sentences.en: Corpse bearers in Mumbai unionized in 2003, and every so often, rumor spreads about a strike.
sentences.zh: 孟买的遗体抬送员于2003年成立了工会，每隔一段时间，就会有罢工的谣言传出。

sentences.en: As Dinsha and I continued on through the Dungravadi, we walked the perimeter of one of the towers.
sentences.zh: 当迪恩肖和我继续穿过登加瓦迪时，我们沿着其中一座塔楼的外围步行。

sentences.en: Our guide told us that about 35 bodies were currently up there.
sentences.zh: 我们的向导告诉我们，目前那上面大约有35具遗体。

sentences.en: I could smell a distinct rotting as I walked the circumference of this tower,
sentences.zh: 当我沿着这座塔的周长行走时，我能闻到一股明显的腐烂气味，

sentences.en: but if I willed myself to believe it was fresh compost I was smelling, I probably could.
sentences.zh: 但如果我强迫自己相信闻到的是新鲜堆肥，我可能也能做到。

sentences.en: A couple days later, I brought this observation up to Kogeste.
sentences.zh: 几天后，我把这个观察结果告诉了科杰斯特。

sentences.en: Just because people have the issue of smell, do you stop an entire system which supports a forest?
sentences.zh: 仅仅因为人们对气味有意见，你就要叫停一个支持森林的整个系统吗？

sentences.en: Do you change the religion and religious practices just because of smell?
sentences.zh: 难道你要仅仅因为气味就改变宗教和宗教习俗吗？

sentences.en: Kojeste thinks that focusing on smell is misguided, but there is something he feels increasingly concerned about.
sentences.zh: 科杰斯特认为过于关注气味是错误的，但他有一件感到日益担忧的事情。

sentences.en: We have a problem now, high-rise buildings coming up around Dungarwadi.
sentences.zh: 我们现在有个问题，登加瓦迪周围正在兴建高层建筑。

sentences.en: The scale of development that Mumbai has seen in the last few decades is colossal.
sentences.zh: 孟买在过去几十年里经历的开发规模是巨大的。

sentences.en: Back when Dinsha Thamboli received that threatening letter from overlooking neighbors of Dungarwadi,
sentences.zh: 当年迪恩肖·坦博利收到来自登加瓦迪俯瞰邻居的威胁信时，

sentences.en: there were only two high-rises in the area.
sentences.zh: 该地区只有两栋高层建筑。

sentences.en: Kojaste told me that back then, even his home, where I met him,
sentences.zh: 科杰斯特告诉我，当时甚至连我见到他的那栋房子，

sentences.en: was once Dungarwadi land before it turned into a housing complex.
sentences.zh: 在变成住宅区之前也曾是登加瓦迪的土地。

sentences.en: Till 123 years ago, panthers were roaming around where you're sitting today.
sentences.zh: 直到123年前，豹子还在你今天坐的地方四处游荡。

sentences.en: This is part of Dungarwadi land where this building has come up.
sentences.zh: 这座拔地而起的建筑所在的土地就是登加瓦迪的一部分。

sentences.en: But today, the Dungarwadi neighborhood looks like a forest of skyscrapers surrounding the actual foreSt.
sentences.zh: 但今天，登加瓦迪街区看起来就像是一片摩天大楼森林包围着真正的森林。

sentences.en: Next to the Dungarwadi's main arched entranceway, a tall billboard advertises the modern comforts of life.
sentences.zh: 在登加瓦迪主要的拱形入口旁，一块巨大的广告牌宣传着现代生活的舒适。

sentences.en: Cars, handbags, life insurance.
sentences.zh: 汽车、手袋、人寿保险。

sentences.en: the industrial clang of luxury apartment construction is constant.
sentences.zh: 豪华公寓建设的工业敲打声连绵不断。

sentences.en: All the time.
sentences.zh: 无时无刻不在进行。

sentences.en: This road, I think at the moment there might be no less than 10 new projects.
sentences.zh: 这条路，我想目前可能不少于10个新项目。

sentences.en: So possibly, you know, 20, 30 buildings coming up.
sentences.zh: 所以可能，你知道的，有20、30栋建筑正在兴建。

sentences.en: And presumably there are going to be high-rises.
sentences.zh: 而且想必全都是高层建筑。

sentences.en: All will be high-rises.
sentences.zh: 全部都会是高层建筑。

sentences.en: Because this being one of the poshest areas of Mumbai, Malabah Hill,
sentences.zh: 因为这里是孟买最高档的地区之一，马拉巴尔山，

sentences.en: it is just going to be super expensive, multi-storied buildings,
sentences.zh: 这里将全都是超级昂贵的多层建筑，

sentences.en: and all of them are going to be overlooking Dungarwadi.
sentences.zh: 而且所有这些建筑都将俯瞰登加瓦迪。

sentences.en: That's Rashne Pardivala again.
sentences.zh: 这位又是拉什内·帕迪瓦拉。

sentences.en: At the moment, we've got possibly seven buildings overlooking.
sentences.zh: 目前，我们大概有七栋俯瞰的建筑。

sentences.en: I think in the next 10 years, we will just be surrounded 360 degrees.
sentences.zh: 我认为在接下来的10年里，我们将迎来360度全方位的包围。

sentences.en: We will be surrounded by tall towers.
sentences.zh: 我们将被高楼大厦所包围。

sentences.en: As an ecologist, Rashne has been planting trees around the circumference of each tower.
sentences.zh: 作为一名生态学家，拉什内一直在每座塔楼的周围种植树木。

sentences.en: Trees like bamboo that grow tall and fast and can obscure the view from surrounding buildings.
sentences.zh: 像竹子这样生长迅速的高大树木，可以遮挡周边建筑的视线。

sentences.en: But as Kojeste once told me,
sentences.zh: 但正如科杰斯特曾经对我说的那样，

sentences.en: Lasha, the bottom line is that, as I now know,
sentences.zh: 拉沙，最底线是，正如我现在所知，

sentences.en: the vultures are ancillary to the system.
sentences.zh: 秃鹫只是这个系统的辅助部分。

sentences.en: The most important is the sun.
sentences.zh: 最重要的是太阳。

sentences.en: With the absence of vultures,
sentences.zh: 在没有秃鹫的情况下，

sentences.en: the sun is the only thing that can break down the bodies of deceased Parsis.
sentences.zh: 太阳是分解已故帕西人遗体的唯一途径。

sentences.en: But the taller these apartment buildings rise,
sentences.zh: 但这些公寓楼建得越高，

sentences.en: and then, in turn, the taller these trees that are meant to obstruct their views rise,
sentences.zh: 进而，那些旨在遮挡它们视线的树木也长得越高，

sentences.en: it also means that it'll be harder for the sun's rays to reach the bodies atop the towers.
sentences.zh: 这也意味着阳光将更难照射到塔楼顶部的遗体上。

sentences.en: And really, at this point, sunlight is all there is that's left to decompose these bodies.
sentences.zh: 说实话，到了这个地步，阳光是分解这些遗体仅存的全部依靠了。

sentences.en: The whole forest is going to be in darkness and in shadow.
sentences.zh: 整片森林都将陷入黑暗和阴影之中。

sentences.en: Is that going to serve the purpose?
sentences.zh: 这能达到目的吗？

sentences.en: That's going to be counterproductive to the Rukmishai system.
sentences.zh: 这与鲁克米什艾系统将背道而驰。

sentences.en: So these are tough, tough challenges.
sentences.zh: 所以这些都是非常艰难的挑战。

sentences.en: In 2015, a Parsi crematorium was finally established in Mumbai, though not inside the Dungravadi.
sentences.zh: 2015年，孟买终于建立了一个帕西火葬场，尽管不在登加瓦迪内部。

sentences.en: And Dinshot Damboli, former member of the Bombay Parsi Panchayat, was one of the key people behind setting it up.
sentences.zh: 孟买帕西委员会前成员迪恩肖·达姆博利是促成其建立的关键人物之一。

sentences.en: Some Parsis are afraid that if cremation and burial grow in popularity and fewer and fewer people take to the towers,
sentences.zh: 一些帕西人担心，如果火葬和土葬变得越来越受欢迎，越来越少的人选择将遗体送往塔楼，

sentences.en: and in the face of encroaching development, that the Dungravadi land might be taken away from them.
sentences.zh: 并且面对不断蚕食的开发，登加瓦迪的土地可能会被夺走。

sentences.en: So once we have buildings surrounding us, 360 degrees, what is going to be the solution?
sentences.zh: 所以一旦我们被360度全方位的高楼包围，解决方案会是什么呢？

sentences.en: Right now, one person is complaining.
sentences.zh: 现在，是一个人在抱怨。

sentences.en: Tomorrow, 10 people will complain.
sentences.zh: 明天，就会有10个人抱怨。

sentences.en: Tomorrow, if we've got, you know, thousands of residents complaining to the municipal corporation,
sentences.zh: 明天，如果我们有成千上万的居民向市政当局抱怨，

sentences.en: the municipal corporation is going to be forced to address the issue.
sentences.zh: 市政当局将被迫处理这个问题。

sentences.en: And then are they going to really weigh the religious sentiments of a community up against an entire, you know, larger community that might take objection?
sentences.zh: 到那时，他们真的会把一个社群的宗教情感与可能提出异议的整个更大社群进行权衡吗？

sentences.en: With real estate in Malabar Hill priced around $800 per square foot, the Dungarwadi could be worth about $2 billion.
sentences.zh: 鉴于马拉巴尔山的房地产价格约为每平方英尺800美元，登加瓦迪的价值可能高达约20亿美元。

sentences.en: But the Parsi's own this land.
sentences.zh: 但帕西人拥有这片土地。

sentences.en: It belongs to them.
sentences.zh: 它属于他们。

sentences.en: So I had to ask Roshne to lay out more clearly
sentences.zh: 所以我不得不请罗什内更清楚地阐述，

sentences.en: why there seems to be this vague but collective fear
sentences.zh: 为什么人们似乎对土地被夺走有一种模糊但集体的恐惧。

sentences.en: of the land being taken away from them.
sentences.zh: 好吧，那我这样回答这个问题。

sentences.en: Okay, so let me answer the question this way.
sentences.zh: 随着帕西社群的萎缩，

sentences.en: As the Parsi community has dwindled,
sentences.zh: 随着人口数量的下降，

sentences.en: as the numbers have fallen,
sentences.zh: 我们在印度的其他地方看到，

sentences.en: we have seen in other parts of India
sentences.zh: 由于那里没有帕西人口，

sentences.en: where because there is no Parsi population,
sentences.zh: 当地的帕西委员会，

sentences.en: the local Parsi panchayat,
sentences.zh: 当地的帕西委员会

sentences.en: has been forced to sell the land because there are no Parsis.
sentences.zh: 由于没有了帕西人，被迫出售这块土地。

sentences.en: And that's happened across India.
sentences.zh: 这种情况在整个印度都有发生。

sentences.en: And so if there are no Parsis left, the land will be taken over by the government.
sentences.zh: 因此，如果再也没有帕西人剩下，这片土地将被政府接管。

sentences.en: This is something Rashne has seen herself.
sentences.zh: 这是拉什内亲眼所见的事情。

sentences.en: On a recent work trip, she visited a city called Jalna,
sentences.zh: 在最近的一次工作旅行中，她访问了一个叫做贾尔纳的城市，

sentences.en: which used to have a big Parsi community.
sentences.zh: 这里过去曾有一个庞大的帕西人社区。

sentences.en: When I visited Jalna, there hadn't been a single Parsi in Jalna for the past 37 years.
sentences.zh: 当我访问贾尔纳时，过去37年里贾尔纳连一个帕西人都没有了。

sentences.en: The whole Parsi population had been wiped clean.
sentences.zh: 整个帕西人口已经被彻底抹去。

sentences.en: Not only were there no Parsis left, but there was also no functioning Dungurwadi.
sentences.zh: 不仅没有剩下帕西人，而且也没有一个仍在运作的天葬台。

sentences.en: What used to be the Dungurwadi is now government land.
sentences.zh: 曾经的天葬台现在成了政府的土地。

sentences.en: When I went there, he showed me a dogma.
sentences.zh: 当我到那里时，他向我展示了一个达克玛。

sentences.en: I asked him, what's that?
sentences.zh: 我问他，那是什么？

sentences.en: He was saying, a well.
sentences.zh: 他说，是一口井。

sentences.en: I said, what well?
sentences.zh: 我说，什么井？

sentences.en: No, somebody said it's a well.
sentences.zh: 不，有人说是口井。

sentences.en: I said, it's not a well, it's a dogma.
sentences.zh: 我说，这不是井，这是达克玛。

sentences.en: And the locals said, oh, we don't know what that is.
sentences.zh: 当地人说，哦，我们不知道那是什么。

sentences.en: The towers and their sacred role, it had all been forgotten.
sentences.zh: 那些石塔及其神圣的使命，全都被遗忘了。

sentences.en: I had seen this too.
sentences.zh: 我也见过这种情况。

sentences.en: In a different town, I visited an abandoned Dungravadi with a couple defunct towers of silence.
sentences.zh: 在另一个小镇，我参观了一个废弃的天葬台，里面有几座荒废的寂静之塔。

sentences.en: Due to the population loss of Parsis, there were no more priests left to administer the death
sentences.zh: 由于帕西人口的减少，已经没有牧师来主持死亡

sentences.en: rituals.
sentences.zh: 仪式了。

sentences.en: So the panchayat in that town started leasing the land to non-Parsi farmers.
sentences.zh: 因此，那个镇上的长老会开始将土地租给非帕西族农民。

sentences.en: They had
sentences.zh: 他们

sentences.en: been using one of the empty dakmas to store a giant pile of castor oil seeds.
sentences.zh: 一直用其中一座空置的天葬台来存放一大堆蓖麻籽。

sentences.en: One other abandoned
sentences.zh: 另一个废弃的

sentences.en: tower had a large solar panel above it, creating solar energy to irrigate the land for sandalwood
sentences.zh: 石塔上方装有一个大型太阳能电池板，利用太阳能发电来为檀香
